name: Zercher Front-Foot Elevated Split Squat
instructions: Hold a barbell in the crooks of your elbows against your chest.
Place your front foot on a low plate and step the other foot back.
Drive up through the front foot.
longevityNotes: Single-leg strength and balance are what keep you steady on uneven ground and stairs. Lunge work trains the stability that prevents the falls that change lives.
overview: A split squat holding a barbell in the crook of your elbows with the front foot elevated.
